title: Chicken and Mushroom Wild Rice Soup
description: Nutty wild rice and tender chicken thighs meet in a sage-scented mushroom broth.

steps.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps.text: Slice {mush} and cut {chicken} into ¾-inch pieces.

steps.title: Set up the pot
steps.text: Use the enamel Dutch oven on a medium burner; adjust the flame to hold a bare simmer.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.text: Cook the mushrooms in {butter} for 6 minutes. Add {sage}, {garlic} and {ap}; stir for 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Pour in {broth} gradually. Add the chicken and simmer gently for 15–20 minutes until 175°F at the center of the largest piece.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in {wild} and {milk}. Gently heat 5 minutes, stirring to keep the rice suspended.

notes: Make ahead: chill in shallow containers within 2 hours and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze in meal-size containers for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: stir over medium-low heat to 165°F, adding a splash of water as needed. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat to 165°F. Dairy swap: replace each dairy ingredient with unsweetened oat milk or an equivalent dairy-free butter or cheese. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 263 kcal, 28.8 g protein, 19.9 g total carbohydrate, 7.6 g fat, 1.8 g fiber, 152 mg sodium.
